positioning.title: Industry LLMs and business agents,
positioning.titleHighlight: focused on problems that happen in real operations
positioning.description: Many AI projects fail to land not because models are weak, but because they never enter the details of workflows, data definitions, and collaboration. We start from concrete scenarios and turn capabilities into reusable business agents that keep improving.

items.title: Go deep into industry scenarios
items.description: Understand goals, roles, and process bottlenecks first, then decide which steps an agent should take.

items.title: Build super business agents
items.description: Around one clear responsibility: read data, call tools, work with people, and keep producing results in the workflow.

items.title: Co-create closely with customers
items.description: Clarify requirements, validate prototypes, connect systems, and improve from usage feedback together.

method.title: From scenario to agent,
method.description: Start from one clear pain point, build a small verifiable loop first, then expand to more roles and workflows.

steps.title: Identify business pain points
steps.description: High-frequency tasks, collaboration gaps, decision pressure — define the agent's responsibility boundary.

steps.title: Prepare data and knowledge
steps.description: Connect systems, documents, metrics, and past cases into a traceable, governable data foundation.

steps.title: Design the model and tool chain
steps.description: Combine LLMs, retrieval, rules, and business tools so the agent completes tasks, not only answers.

steps.title: Iterate into production
steps.description: Pilot, evaluate, feed back, operate — embed in real workflows instead of staying in a demo.

principles: No over-promising: validate value first, then expand
Stay inside customer systems and existing workflows
Deliver more than pages: data, knowledge, permissions, operations

capabilities.title: Not just a tool or a generic model,
capabilities.titleHighlight: AI landed in specific roles, workflows, and scenarios
capabilities.description: Industry knowledge, intelligent data, model engineering, and agent orchestration combined — with equal attention to technical implementation, business usability, and ongoing operation.

items.title: Industry LLM applications
items.description: Domain corpus, knowledge bases, and business rules for professional Q&A, assessment, generation, and explanation.

items.title: Agent orchestration
items.description: Task breakdown, tool calling, access control, human confirmation, and result tracking.

items.title: Intelligent data foundation
items.description: Data assets, knowledge structures, metric definitions, and quality rules as trusted context for models.

items.title: Digital twin and simulation
items.description: Space, equipment, resource, and event simulation for situational awareness and decision support.

cta.title: Start co-creation from one business pain point
